name: Galardell Valley
summary: Gnolls prowl Galardell Valley beneath the Tower of Ilgalar in northeastern Redridge. The canyon is a danger to the settlements nearby.

sections.title: A Den of Beasts and Shadow
sections.body: Redridge gnolls prowl Galardell Valley, beyond the reach of Lakeshire's defenders. They roam the lowlands and camp along the canyon floor under brutal pack leaders such as Lieutenant Fangore. Above the ravines rises the Tower of Ilgalar, stronghold of the renegade mage Morganth. The gnolls and the tower keep the valley a source of dread for nearby settlements.

faq.answer: Galardell Valley lies in the far northeastern corner of the Redridge Mountains, behind the high crags beyond the roads leading north from Lake Everstill.

faq.q: What creatures live in the valley?
faq.answer: Bloodthirsty gnoll packs roam the valley trails in dense groups, led by dangerous brutes such as Lieutenant Fangore.

faq.q: What is the dark tower overlooking the valley?
faq.answer: The Tower of Ilgalar is the stone stronghold of the rogue sorcerer Morganth, overlooking the valley.
Lieutenant Fangore is a formidable gnoll leader in the valley. Cunning and fierce, he howls for aid from nearby gnoll packs when challenged, and they can quickly overwhelm unwary travelers.

angles.text: Lakeshire's overwhelmed town guard cannot secure the northeast road while gnoll packs and Morganth's dark presence hold Galardell Valley.
